instruction.text: Look at the line graph and choose the three statements which correctly describe the vertical axis.

b: ++The vertical axis starts at 0.
The vertical axis starts at 10.
++The vertical axis is labelled 'score'.
The vertical axis is labelled 'age'.
++The vertical axis goes up in steps of 1 point.
The vertical axis goes up in steps of 2 points.

text: The vertical axis is labelled 'score', indicating that the values on it represent the pupils’ average score. It starts at 0 and goes up to 10 in intervals of 1 point.

instruction.text: Look at the line graph and choose the three statements which correctly describe the horizontal axis.

b: ++The horizontal axis starts at 0.
The horizontal axis starts at 5.
++The horizontal axis is labelled 'week'.
The horizontal axis is labelled 'day'.
++The horizontal axis goes up in steps of 1 week.
The horizontal axis goes up in steps of 1 day.

text: The horizontal axis is labelled 'week', indicating that each value represents a different week, starting at 0 and going up in steps of 1 week each time.

instruction.text: Look at the line graph and choose the correct statement.

b: The graph shows 2 weeks worth of data.
The graph shows 4 weeks worth of data.
++The graph shows 6 weeks worth of data.

text: Knowing that each value on the horizontal axis represents a different week, you can count the values on the horizontal axis to find out how many weeks worth of data are shown on the graph.

instruction.text: Look at the line graph and choose the correct statement.

b.sound: This graph shows the average temperature in January between 2017 and 2022.
This graph shows the average temperature for every day in January.

text: The title of the graph tells us that we are looking at data related to the average temperature in January. The 'years' label on the horizontal axis tells us that the numbers each represent a different year. By looking closer at the horizontal axis, we can see that the graph displays data from years 2017 - 2022.

instruction.text: Look at the line graph and choose the two statements which correctly describe the vertical axis

b: ++The vertical axis shows temperature in degrees celsius.
The vertical axis shows temperature in degrees fahrenheit.
++The vertical axis starts at 0 degrees.
The vertical axis starts at 9 degrees.

text: The label on the vertical axis shows us that the values represent temperature in degrees celsius and that they start at 0 and go up to 9 degrees.

instruction.text: Look at the line graph and choose the two statements which correctly describe the horizontal axis

b: ++The horizontal axis is labelled 'years'.
The horizontal axis is labelled 'days'.
The horizontal axis is labelled 'months'.
There are 3 years’ worth of data displayed on the horizontal axis.
There are 5 years’ worth of data displayed on the horizontal axis.
++There are 6 years’ worth of data displayed on the horizontal axis.

text: Remember, the label on the horizontal axis indicates that each value represents a year.
